test_policy.notes: Applicants choose on the application whether UB considers their SAT/ACT scores; test scores are not required for an admission decision and applicants who opt out are still reviewed for merit scholarships.

requirements.notes: Complete only one of ApplySUNY (select 'Buffalo, University at'), the Common App or the Coalition application; $50 non-refundable fee. Holistic review considers academic marks, test scores, essay and recommendations; UB strongly recommends at least one letter of recommendation (up to three accepted). Transcripts are self-reported. Intended major selection matters: direct admission to accounting and business management is limited enrollment, engineering applications get an additional review, and acting, dance, music theatre, music and BFA design/technology require an audition or portfolio/interview.

deadlines.label: Early Action (non-binding)
deadlines.notes: Early Action applicants get a priority response and priority consideration for merit scholarships; decisions come on a rolling basis (CDS). Enrollment deposit due May 1 or 10 days after acceptance, whichever is later. Honors College priority consideration Dec 15.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision application completion deadline
deadlines.notes: Applications can continue to be submitted after this date until capacity is reached. The page states these dates for the international first-year tab; no year is printed, so the current cycle is assumed (application opens Aug 1).

english_policy.waiver_notes: In general required for applicants whose native language is not English and who completed any part of high school in a non-English-speaking country. Alternatives accepted instead of a test: ACT English and reading each 18+, SAT ERWS 500+, AP English Language 4+ or a B in the class, British IGCSE/GCE English result of C. Scores must be under two years old.

english.notes: Minimum to be eligible for consideration; MyBest scores allowed. Page lists '70 or 4' (old 0-120 scale or new 1-6 scale).
PTE Academic or PTE Academic Online.

aid.notes: UB offers scholarships in varying amounts to incoming first-year international students with no prior college credit (fall or spring entry), renewable up to four years; all admitted international students are automatically considered. The scholarships page does not mention need-based aid for international students, so that is left unconfirmed.

majors.notes: Page says direct admission to accounting and business management is subject to limited enrollment.
